messages:
Priya (CS): Heads-up — EU onboarding webhooks returned intermittent 502s over the weekend, roughly 42 tenants affected. Drafting customer comms and a short script for CS reps. Need: exec-friendly summary, renewal-risk tagging, and a quick FAQ.

Maya (CS): Thanks — can you share the tenant list? I can start sorting high-touch / renewal in next 24h. :mag:  I have a few customers with renewals in next 30 days.

Priya (CS): Pasted private list to the shared drive (internal) and flagged 12 high-touch accounts. I'll add renewal windows column.

Omar (Support): Root cause appears to be an EU-side autoscaling regression + a rate-limit misconfig in our webhook proxy. DeployBot shows a rollback on Sat 03:12 UTC.

DeployBot: deploy/redwood-proxy v2.14.1 -> v2.14.2 triggered automatic rollback at 2026-03-21T03:12:47Z due to error 502 spike.

Elena (Solutions): For the customer-facing note, let's be explicit about impact and mitigation steps. Customers appreciate a short timeline, what we did, and next steps (including a contact link). Keep it < 5 bullets.

Jules (RevOps): We should attach a one-time goodwill credit for impacted tenants with rolling renewals this quarter. I'll draft a standard credit line we can reuse.

Maya (CS): Quick ask — can someone confirm whether any PII/transcript payloads were retried/exposed? Security triage? @Omar

Omar (Support): Verified no data loss and retries were idempotent; logs show retries returned 502 but no partial writes. Security already confirmed no exfil.

Priya (CS): Draft customer script below — please review and shorten where needed. Use `{{customer_name}}` placeholders.

Priya (CS): ```
Hi {{customer_name}},
We wanted to let you know that we experienced a service disruption affecting webhook deliveries for customers in the EU region between 2026-03-20 22:45 UTC and 2026-03-21 04:00 UTC. During this period, some onboarding events were delayed or retried.

What happened: a deployment introduced an autoscaling config regression which caused intermittent 502 responses from the EU webhook proxy.
What we did: rolled back the release within 5 minutes of detecting the spike, applied a hotfix to the autoscaler settings, and validated webhook replay/consistency for affected tenants.
What this means for you: most webhook deliveries were retried automatically and processed successfully. If you see missing events or duplicates, reply to this thread and we will help reconcile.
Compensation: we are offering a one-time credit for affected tenants renewing in the next 90 days — please contact your CSM to apply.
Questions/Help: schedule a 30-min office hours slot here: https://redwood.company/office-hours

We apologize for the disruption — thank you for your patience.
Regards,
The Redwood Inference Team
```

Elena (Solutions): Nice. Suggest adding a short bullet for "Action for high-touch customers" — offer priority replay and a dedicated sync.

Priya (CS): Good call — updated script: added "We will offer priority webhook replay and a dedicated sync for high-touch customers; your CSM will reach out."

Jules (RevOps): Proposed credit language: "We will apply a one-time account credit equivalent to 10% of your most recent monthly invoice, redeemable at renewal or applied to your next invoice." Approve?

Maya (CS): 10% seems reasonable. Approve from CS side. I'll flag which accounts qualify and send a note to billing.

Omar (Support): Follow-up ask — engineering will publish a short RCA doc by EOD Tuesday. Include link in customer note when available.

Priya (CS): Timeline plan: 1) Initial customer note (short) — send in next 2 hours with what we know + credit offer + contact link; 2) Follow-up with RCA and technical appendix once engineering posts (EOD Tue); 3) Offer office hours for high-touch customers tomorrow + prioritized replay within 48h.

Elena (Solutions): Can we include a one-paragraph non-technical executive summary for renewals owners? I'll draft and drop here.

Elena (Solutions): "Executive summary: A deploy to our EU webhook proxy triggered an autoscaler misconfiguration, causing transient 502s that led to delayed onboarding event deliveries for ~42 tenants. We rolled back the deploy quickly, performed a targeted fix, and validated event consistency. We are offering credits and prioritized remediation for impacted customers. Full RCA to follow."

Maya (CS): Perfect. I'll use that in the customer email subject line and the tailored account notes.

Priya (CS): Quick ops checklist for CS reps to follow when reaching out: 
- Confirm renewal date and mark renewal-risk if within 60 days
- Offer prioritized replay and schedule office hours
- Apply credit if account qualifies (Jules will confirm)
- Capture feedback via form: https://redwood.company/cs-feedback (1-2 min)

Jules (RevOps): I'll sync with billing and confirm which accounts get auto-credit. ETA 6 hours.

Omar (Support): Engineering note: adding a circuit-breaker test and tighter autoscaler validation to CI to prevent recurrence. RCA draft link (internal): https://redwood.company/rca/eu-webhook-20260321 (will update).

Priya (CS): Thanks all — I'll push the initial note to the 42 tenants now and follow up with the RCA link when ready. Please add any last-minute edits in the next 15 minutes. :pray: 

Maya (CS): On it. I'll prepare the high-touch scheduling invites.

Elena (Solutions): I'll prepare the recovery playbook for any customers that report inconsistent states.

Jules (RevOps): Noted — will confirm credits and update the compensation template.

Priya (CS): Closing loop later with a quick post-send status update here.
